title: Back into the project
task: Help someone recover the thread of a personal project after a long break.
notice: Exploratory ideas, not built prototypes or cultural studies. Human review unrecorded.

synthesis.title: Rewind Trail: scrub fast, pause to reflect, pin the thread
synthesis.action: User scrubs backward through fictional snapshots by dial, drag, or arrow keys; holding still pauses.
synthesis.feedback: Each pause shows a tentative last-intent card with source notes; user marks still-true, stale, or edits.
synthesis.mechanism: Scrub speed switches modes: fast shows glances, pausing opens a reflection prompt on contradictions.
synthesis.difference: Navigation speed itself toggles immediacy and reflection; recovery comes from user verdicts, not summaries.
synthesis.risks: Inferred intents may anchor users; long histories overwhelm; marking fatigue; verdicts may entrench errors.
synthesis.feasibility: Offline single-page app: fictional JSON, slider plus keyboard, ARIA live region, undoable verdict states.
synthesis.prototype: Proposed untested mock with twenty fictional snapshots; measure time-to-correct-next-step versus plain notes baseline.

proposals.title: Rewind Dial: scrub your project backward, then pin the thread
proposals.action: User drags a dial backward through fictional project snapshots, pausing anywhere.
proposals.feedback: Each pause shows one last-intent sentence; user edits or rejects it.
proposals.mechanism: Fast scrubbing gives immediacy; pausing opens a slow reflection prompt.
proposals.difference: Navigation speed itself switches between glancing and reflecting, not buttons.
proposals.risks: Inferred intents may mislead; scrubbing could overwhelm long histories.
proposals.feasibility: Local web prototype with fictional notes JSON and slider.
proposals.prototype: Paper-test twenty fictional snapshots; observe corrections and resumed next step.

proposals.title: Thread Splice
proposals.action: Drag a fictional project note onto a draft resume-point card.
proposals.feedback: Card shows guessed next step, marked tentative, with source notes.
proposals.mechanism: Quick splice now; deliberate reflection pass edits each inferred link later.
proposals.difference: Recovery is built by visibly joining fragments, not reading summaries.
proposals.risks: Wrong inferences may anchor users; reflection pass might be skipped.
proposals.feasibility: Local JSON state, undo stack, single-page offline web app.
proposals.prototype: Paper-plus-HTML mock using fictional notes; untested, user study planned.

proposals.title: Cold Trail Sorting
proposals.action: User sorts dealt cards of past notes into 'still true' or 'stale'.
proposals.feedback: Each sort instantly redraws a timeline showing surviving intentions.
proposals.mechanism: Quick swipe judgments first, then slow reflection on contradictions surfaced.
proposals.difference: Recovery through user verdicts on old beliefs, not automated summaries.
proposals.risks: Fast sorting may entrench wrong judgments; misread fictional notes.
proposals.feasibility: Local fictional JSON notes, card UI, timeline rendered in browser.
proposals.prototype: Clickable offline mockup; observe sort hesitations and undo frequency.

proposals.title: Breadcrumb Rewind: keyboard-walked trail of last project steps
proposals.action: User steps backward through dated notes using arrow keys.
proposals.feedback: Each step speaks a one-line summary; screen reader announces position.
proposals.mechanism: Press space to mark step 'still true' or 'outdated'.
proposals.difference: Recovery happens by confirming past states, not reading summaries.
proposals.risks: Stale notes may mislead; marking fatigue on long trails.
proposals.feasibility: Local JSON of fictional notes, plain HTML, ARIA live region.
proposals.prototype: Single offline page with twenty fictional notes and keyboard tests.

synthesis.title: Re-stitching Stage: resuming a paused project
synthesis.action: User pulls loose thread cards onto a stage, ordering, flagging, or relabeling each fragment.
synthesis.feedback: Center cards reveal last decision, open question, date; wings hold unconfirmed or stale notes neutrally.
synthesis.mechanism: A thread-tension slider switches quick glance stitching versus slow reflective re-stitching per fragment.
synthesis.difference: Spatial stitching with adjustable pace replaces summary feeds, timelines, and button lists.
synthesis.risks: Metaphor may confuse or feel slow; neutral wording avoids shame about breaks.
synthesis.feasibility: Offline browser canvas app using local fictional JSON fragments and local storage.
synthesis.prototype: Paper stage with thread cards, then HTML drag mockup with undo, relabel, reweight controls.

proposals.title: Loose Stitches: re-binding a paused project
proposals.action: User tugs frayed threads linking past notes to resume work.
proposals.feedback: Each tug shows the joint's last decision, open question, date.
proposals.mechanism: Projects are bound seams; breaks fray joints needing deliberate re-stitching.
proposals.difference: Recovery is physical repair, not a summary feed or timeline.
proposals.risks: Fraying metaphor may shame users; tone must stay gentle.
proposals.feasibility: Local web app with fictional notes and simple graph storage.
proposals.prototype: Paper-and-thread mockup, then offline HTML seam editor with undo.

proposals.title: Reservoir Rewind
proposals.action: User drains a project reservoir, releasing remembered tasks layer by layer.
proposals.feedback: Sediment layers show stale notes; clear water shows confident recent progress.
proposals.mechanism: Dragging a sluice gate controls recall flow rate, fast or reflective.
proposals.difference: Recall speed is a physical flow, not a list or button.
proposals.risks: Metaphor may confuse; uncertain notes could be over-trusted or ignored.
proposals.feasibility: Simple offline canvas app using fictional project logs and local storage.
proposals.prototype: Paper sluice slider plus clickable sediment layers users can relabel.

proposals.title: Re-entry Stage
proposals.action: User drags fictional project fragments onto a stage, ordering their entrances.
proposals.feedback: Fragments nearer center brighten; distant ones fade into wings.
proposals.mechanism: Proximity on stage encodes relevance; entrance order rebuilds narrative thread.
proposals.difference: Spatial blocking replaces lists, balancing quick glance with staged reflection.
proposals.risks: Metaphor may confuse; arranging could feel slow for urgent restarts.
proposals.feasibility: Simple offline canvas app with local fictional JSON fragments.
proposals.prototype: Paper stage with cards, then browser drag-and-drop mockup.

proposals.title: Airlock Inventory: Re-entering a Dormant Project Habitat
proposals.action: User walks virtual habitat rooms, tagging each stored project item.
proposals.feedback: Items show dust levels; tagging clears dust and reveals last notes.
proposals.mechanism: Quick triage stamps first, then optional reflective repair logs per item.
proposals.difference: Spatial triage replaces timelines; resumption feels like physical re-entry.
proposals.risks: Metaphor may feel slow; dust could imply shame about breaks.
proposals.feasibility: Offline web prototype with local fictional project JSON data.
proposals.prototype: Three-room paper or HTML mockup; user edits, undoes, re-tags items.
